name: adapt_role_list_typescript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: allowedRoles.txt (a spec file the role check must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old list into roles.ts
prompts: Create roles.ts that exports a function isAllowed(role: string): boolean returning true if role is in the comma-separated list in allowedRoles.txt (currently: admin, editor), else false. Read the list from the file (fs.readFileSync) at call time - do not hardcode it.
allowedRoles.txt has changed. Make sure isAllowed() reflects the CURRENT list in the file.

disruptions.description: allowedRoles.txt rewritten to add a new role

check_command: tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build roles.ts test_roles.ts && node build/test_roles.js
